current_activity: Scheldt: Buffaloes of the 1st Assault Brigade R.E. (79th Armoured Division) land the 52nd Division on South Beveland at Ellewoutsdijk
notes: Event date: 26 October 1944 (Ellis, vol. II, pp. 111-113). Event definition: The 156th Brigade of the 52nd (Lowland) Division makes an amphibious landing on South Beveland from Terneuzen in Buffaloes of the 79th Armoured Division (1st Assault Brigade, Royal Engineers); the 157th Brigade follows. By the end of the day a bridgehead has been secured, its right about a mile south of Hoedekenskerke and its left about two miles from Ellewoutsdijk.
